sections.appearance: Hinata is a well-endowed young woman. She has messy black hip-length hair. She have red eyes and a cute young face. Halo ==== Hinata's halo have a yellow color and it have two little wings and a lot of small lines interacting the halo. Uniform ==== Hinata wears a short nun-like dress. Her sleeves are detached and have a bigger start. The skirt has a slit on both sides. She wears white high tights that are held by a black leg garter. Firearm ==== She utilizes a black chrome Desert Eagle Mk. I pistol with gold wings on the slide and a gold cross on the grip. For her EX Skill, she unpacks a Mk19 Automatic Grenade Launcher from her luggage bag.
